scientific_requirements: Score only independent final scientific conclusions, with fixed pass/fail weights totaling 100. Actual linked calculations or reproducible data analysis must support each claim with correct chemical identity, physical definition, conditions and reference. Numbers, structures, modes and state assignments are evidence, not author-value acceptance windows or separate process scores. A supplied observation, guessed answer, software execution or copied source value alone earns no credit. A fully supported equivalent explanation or an explicitly permitted evidence-based model-sensitive conclusion passes directly; missing or insufficient evidence and unsupported contradictions fail the affected item. There is no need_review state. One failed item does not erase independent supported points. Whole-case success is assessed separately from the numerical score. AR chooses a justified method; PR assesses the disclosed baseline or substantiates a physically comparable substitution and its consequences. Historical reference defects remain recorded and do not automatically confer success.

rules.expected: Actual state-resolved transition density, NTOs or physically equivalent electronic evidence for NPCZCS S1 establishes hole density mainly on the carbazole–cyanostilbene framework and particle density mainly on the appended naphthalimide, supporting intramolecular charge transfer. Ground-state HOMO/LUMO images or a root label alone are insufficient. No fixed fragment partition, software, centroid cutoff or NTO weight is required.

rules.expected: Actual NPCZCS transition energies and intensities distinguish its S1 from a stronger higher-energy absorption transition, source S2 near 375.88 nm. rules.expected: Compare the three physically assigned lowest singlet energies under matched conditions and explain the acceptor-dependent onset relative to the dominant bright bands. The source-compatible low-energy order is PQCZCS below AQCZCS below NPCZCS; the actual energy differences, uncertainty and transition correspondence must support the claimed ordering. Connect the larger changes of the low onset and the different spatial character (NP/AQ donor-framework-to-acceptor ICT, PQ predominantly phenanthraquinone-local) with the much closer higher bright-band energies. Thus a common donor-acceptor drawing does not imply one universal ICT spectrum. Near-degenerate PQ roots may reorder when the actual low pair and its character are tracked. An evidenced model-sensitive limitation may qualify an unresolved adjacent order, but a copied rank, missing energies, arbitrary root switching or universal ICT assertion fails. No source energy window or solid-state emission conclusion is imposed.
